answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 43909 Country: India Title: Hair Question: Please let me know is it halal for a Muslim man to remove his chest hair? Answer ID: 43909 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 324/324/M=1434) It is lawful but against etiquette. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
